articles.summary: VinFast has signed an initial partnership agreement with NexMove, a joint venture of Transportation Management Services and Zeem Solutions, to bring VinFast e-buses to U.S. customers as a service
articles.title: VINFAST INTRODUCES ELECTRIC BUS LINEUP IN THE U.S, DOUBLING DOWN ON SUSTAINABLE MOBILITY GROWTH

articles.summary: Jakarta, October 5, 2026 – The VinFast VF 3, a mini SUV from Vietnam, has been honoured with the “Trusted & Popular Brand 2026” title in the Passenger BEV category at the Disway Awards 2026. The accolade reflects the VF 3’s strong appeal and growing recognition among Indonesian consumers, while also underscoring VinFast’s ability to understand and respond to the needs of the local market.
articles.title: VINFAST VF 3 HONOURED AS “TRUSTED & POPULAR BRAND 2026” AT DISWAY AWARDS

articles.summary: New Delhi, Octorber 9, 2026: VinFast Auto India, a subsidiary of global electric vehicle manufacturer VinFast, has been awarded the “EV Manufacturer of the Year” at the HT Auto Leaderboard Awards 2026. The recognition highlights VinFast’s growing contribution to India’s electric mobility ecosystem and its focus on building a comprehensive EV proposition spanning products, technology, manufacturing, retail and customer experience.
articles.title: VINFAST INDIA NAMED ‘EV MANUFACTURER OF THE YEAR’ AT HT AUTO LEADERBOARD AWARDS 2026

articles.summary: Hai Phong, October 8, 2026 – VinFast officially signs Letters of Intent (LOIs) with its first 50+ e-motorcycle dealer partners across 15 states and territories in India. The milestone marks an important step in VinFast’s strategy to expand its distribution network, strengthen its position and reinforce the appeal of the Vietnamese brand in one of the world’s largest two-wheeler markets.
articles.title: VINFAST INDIA SIGNS LETTERS OF INTENT WITH FIRST 50+ E-MOTORCYCLE DEALERS, EXPANDING NETWORK TO 15 STATES AND 34 CITIES

articles.summary: Los Angeles, October 13, 2026 – Green SM officially launches its all-electric taxi service in Los Angeles, California, marking the company’s first entry into North America and its ninth global market. Green SM brings modern and safe mobility, professionally operated services and good fares to enhance the everyday travel experience for local residents.
articles.title: GREEN SM OFFICIALLY LAUNCHES ALL-ELECTRIC TAXI SERVICE IN THE U.S.
